description: Perspective3 and Orthographic3 (new, from_fov, accessors, inverse, project_point, project_vector, unproject_point, setters)

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: perspective3_new
ops.doc: Perspective3::new(aspect, fovy, znear, zfar).into_inner()
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: perspective3_accessors
ops.doc: (p.aspect(), p.fovy(), p.znear(), p.zfar()), p = entries (m11, m22, m33, m34)
ops.tolerance: 4 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: perspective3_inverse
ops.doc: p.inverse(), p = entries (m11, m22, m33, m34)
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: perspective3_project_point
ops.doc: p.project_point(&pt), p = entries (m11, m22, m33, m34)
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 2 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: perspective3_project_vector
ops.doc: p.project_vector(&v), p = entries (m11, m22, m33, m34)
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 2 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: perspective3_unproject_point
ops.doc: p.unproject_point(&pt), p = entries (m11, m22, m33, m34)
ops.tolerance: 2 + max_i (|p_i| / 2 + 1) / m_ii: the rounding of w = m34 / (z + m33) (1/2 ulp) amplified by |p_i| / m_ii, the floored product p_i * w divided by m_ii, the final quotient and the floor of the expected value

ops.name: perspective3_set_aspect
ops.doc: p.set_aspect(x), entries (m11, m22, m33, m34) before and after
ops.tolerance: 1 ulp, independent of the inputs

ops.name: perspective3_set_fovy
ops.doc: p.set_fovy(x), entries (m11, m22, m33, m34) before and after
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: perspective3_set_znear
ops.doc: p.set_znear(x), entries (m11, m22, m33, m34) before and after
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: perspective3_set_zfar

ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: perspective3_set_znear_and_zfar
ops.doc: p.set_znear_and_zfar(znear, zfar), entries (m11, m22, m33, m34) before and after
ops.tolerance: 2 ulp, independent of the inputs
